method: Single-shot structural UE4.27 prompt evaluation. Code lines come from fenced blocks; correctness uses deterministic engine-API/safety gates. No Unreal runtime performance is claimed.

tasks.prompt: In Unreal Engine 4.27 C++, make an Actor respawn once after 5 seconds. It currently has Tick disabled.
Implement server-authoritative replicated health in Unreal Engine 4.27 C++ so remote clients and late joiners receive state.
In UE4.27 C++, reference an optional skin that should remain unloaded until selected, then load it safely.
A private cpp file needs TargetModule in this UE4.27 module. Show the smallest correct Build.cs dependency change.
Batch rename Unreal Engine 4.27 assets while preserving references. Give the supported minimal editor automation path.
